description: This bar chart illustrates the ratio values for three large language models – Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT – across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled “Movies”, “Songs”, and “Basketball” in that order, with no apparent sorting. The vertical axis, labeled “Ratio (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 50 to 90, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For each category, there are three bars representing the ratio for each model; Llama3 is represented by blue bars, Qwen2 by red bars, and ChatGPT by yellow bars. In the “Movies” category, the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 84%, the Qwen2 bar reaches approximately 82%, and the ChatGPT bar reaches approximately 72%. For “Songs”, the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 81%, the Qwen2 bar reaches approximately 83%, and the ChatGPT bar reaches approximately 64%. Finally, in the “Basketball” category, the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 68%, the Qwen2 bar reaches approximately 58%, and the ChatGPT bar reaches approximately 62%. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
